Enrolment procedure for first year of thesis at EEATS PhD School
Your application has been accepted by the EEATS PhD school. You only have two more
steps to complete!
1. The admission
1.1 Your ADUM account
Create or connect to your ADUM account at the following address:
http://www.adum.fr/index.pl
→ Fill in each section and save
until all sections have been
validated, then click on « I
finalise the procedure ».
You can ask your thesis director
for help in completing this
information.
→ Once the procedure is
finalised, edit the following from
your personal account:
 The training agreement
 The doctoral charter
September 2025 version
1.2 Your admission file
→ Send the documents below in the order indicated, combined into a single PDF file,
to the doctoral school by email ( ed-eeats@univ-grenoble-alpes.fr ) :
 The training agreement signed by yourself, your thesis director, your co-
director and co-supervisors (if any) and the direction of your laboratory,
 The doctoral charter signed by yourself, your thesis director and the direction
of your laboratory,
 Your Curriculum Vitae,
 A photocopy of your diploma (engineer or master) or a certificate of
completion,
 A proof of financing – This document is not required for winners of the
EEATS PhD school competition.
 Photocopies of your transcripts for the last 2 years of Master or equivalent
grade,
 A photocopy of your identity card or passport.
Your file will be examined by the doctoral school administrators and your speciality head,
who will contact you to set up an interview.
Your file will then be signed by the director of the doctoral school.
You will receive an email from the doctoral school informing you that your admission has
been validated.
2. The enrolment
The Doctoral College’s schooling ( ced-centredinscription@univ-grenoble-alpes.fr ) will
email1 you the enrolment procedure (payment of tuition fees, student card issuance, etc.),
which you can do online or in person.
Don’t hesitate to consult EEATS PhD School’s website
